product.name: Payments
product.description: A platform to accept, process, and settle payments across online, in-person, and unified commerce channels.

product.name: Data
product.description: A data ecosystem that provides insights to optimize business growth, fraud protection, and payment approval rates.

product.name: Finance & Operations
product.description: A financial management platform that optimizes cash flow, automates payouts, and enables card issuance for spending control.

product.name: Accounts
product.description: An embedded business account solution allowing platforms to offer branded accounts for users to manage finances and access funds quickly.

product.name: Capital
product.description: A business financing service offering fast, flexible cash advances embedded into platforms, with automated repayments based on payment data.

product.name: Issuing
product.description: A card issuing platform to create and manage physical and virtual payment cards with customizable controls and branding.
